Headline: #86 Narragansett/Ridgeland Temporary Reroute at Narragansett/North Avenue
ShortDescription: 86 Narragansett/Ridgeland buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions, due to street blockage near Narragansett/North Avenue.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
#86 Narragansett/Ridgeland buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions via Narragansett, North Avenue, Austin, Division, Ridgeland and over regular route, due to street blockage near Narragansett/North Avenue.
